title: RealtimeWAM: How Fast Can I Run My World Action Model?
title_zh: RealtimeWAM：我的世界动作模型能运行得多快？

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) combine visual dynamics modeling with action generation, but their high inference latency limits responsive robot control. Recent efforts accelerate inference by removing explicit future-video generation at test time, as in FastWAM, an approach that requires a specially tailored architectural design. More general caching strategies exploit feature redundancy, but redundancy alone does not capture the changing computational demands of closed-loop control. To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a general, training-free framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for low-latency inference across diverse WAM architectures. We exploit layerwise dependencies to overlap observation processing with prediction. However, concurrent branches still compete for GPU resources, limiting the benefit of parallel execution. We therefore adapt computation throughout the pipeline through selective reuse, caching observation features in visually stable regions and reusing Transformer residuals while reserving additional refinement for small predicted adjustments. We evaluate RealtimeWAM on FastWAM and OpenWAM across RoboTwin, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus. On an RTX 4090, measured mean inference latencies are 24.09 and 63.09 ms, corresponding to average speedups of 8.90 × \times and 10.67 × \times . Average success rates are 82.75% and 87.41%, respectively, within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, RealtimeWAM improves average success rates over native inference by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points on FastWAM and OpenWAM, respectively. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/realtimewam/ .
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将视觉动态建模与动作生成相结合，但其高推理延迟限制了机器人的实时控制能力。 近期的研究通过在测试时移除显式的未来视频生成来加速推理，例如 FastWAM——一种需要专门定制架构设计的方法。 更通用的缓存策略利用了特征冗余性，但仅靠冗余性无法捕捉闭环控制中不断变化的计算需求。 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 RealtimeWAM：一个通用且无需训练的框架，通过协调并行执行与自适应计算，实现在多种 WAM 架构中的低延迟推理。 我们利用各层间的依赖关系，将观察处理与预测过程重叠执行。 然而，并发分支仍会争夺 GPU 资源，从而限制了并行执行带来的优势。 因此，我们通过选择性重用、在视觉稳定区域缓存观察特征、复用 Transformer 残差，并为较小的预测调整保留额外优化，来动态调整整个流程的计算资源。 我们在 RoboTwin、LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 平台上，基于 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 对 RealtimeWAM 进行了评估。 在 RTX 4090 上，测得的平均推理延迟分别为 24.09 毫秒和 63.09 毫秒，对应的加速倍数分别为 8.90 × 和 10.67 ×。 平均成功率分别为 82.75% 和 87.41%，与原生推理结果的差距在 0.02 和 0.53 个百分点以内。 在五个真实世界任务中，RealtimeWAM 相比原生推理，在 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 上的平均成功率分别提升了 17.2 和 37.2 个百分点。 项目页面：https://anonymous.4open.science/w/realtimewam/ .

paragraphs.en: World Action Models (WAMs) integrate visual dynamics modeling with action generation, providing predictive representations for robotic control ( Cen et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . However, their substantial inference cost limits how quickly a robot can respond to changes in its environment. This limitation is particularly problematic in dynamic manipulation, where the scene continues to evolve while the model generates an action ( Black et al., 2025b ) . For example, a moving object on a conveyor may shift away from its observed position before the predicted action is executed. Reducing latency from observation to action is therefore essential for using WAMs to control robots in real time.
paragraphs.zh: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将视觉动态建模与动作生成相结合，为机器人控制提供预测性表示（Cen 等，2025；Bi 等，2025；Kim 等，2026；Yuan 等，2026；Wang 等，2026）。 然而，其高昂的推理成本限制了机器人对环境变化做出响应的速度。 在动态操控中，这一局限性尤为突出，因为模型生成动作的同时，场景仍在持续变化（Black 等，2025b）。 例如，传送带上移动的物体可能在预测动作执行前就已偏离其观测到的位置。 因此，缩短从观察到执行动作的延迟时间，对于实时使用 WAMs 控制机器人至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has reduced inference cost through architectural simplification and computational reuse. For example, FastWAM removes future-video generation at inference while retaining joint training with video ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) , and diffusion caching methods such as TeaCache avoid repeated Transformer computation by reusing residual features ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . These advances leave two further questions for WAM execution in real time. First, reducing computation alone does not resolve how observation processing and prediction should be scheduled under their data dependencies and shared hardware constraints. Second, caching decisions based on denoising similarity are not explicitly tied to the responsiveness and precision required by the current action. Fixed evaluation schedules likewise apply the same computational budget throughout a rollout, despite changing execution requirements. Further acceleration therefore calls for coordinating parallel execution with computation that adapts to the current observation and predicted motion.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究通过简化架构和复用计算资源，降低了推理成本。 例如，FastWAM 在推理时移除了未来视频生成环节，但仍保留了与视频的联合训练（Yuan et al., 2026）；而 TeaCache 等扩散缓存方法则通过复用残差特征，避免了重复的 Transformer 计算（Liu et al., 2025a）。 这些进展为 WAM 的实时执行留下了两个进一步的问题。 首先，仅减少计算量并未解决如何在观测处理与预测之间，依据其数据依赖关系和共享硬件限制进行调度。 其次，基于去噪相似性的缓存决策并未明确与当前动作所需的响应速度和精度挂钩。 固定的评估调度同样在整个执行过程中分配相同的计算资源，尽管实际执行需求可能发生变化。 因此，要实现进一步加速，需要协调并行执行与能够适应当前观测和预测运动的计算过程。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we present RealtimeWAM, a framework that coordinates parallel execution with adaptive computation for existing WAM architectures without additional training. We first exploit the layerwise dependencies between processing the current observation (Prefill) and prediction. As each layer produces the required observation features, the corresponding prediction computation can begin while Prefill continues (Figure 2 ). This allows Prefill to overlap with action prediction and, when present, future-video generation. However, concurrent branches compete for shared GPU compute resources, limiting the speedup achievable through overlap alone.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 RealtimeWAM——一个无需额外训练即可协调现有 WAM 架构中并行执行与自适应计算的框架。 我们首先利用当前观测处理（Prefill）与预测之间的逐层依赖关系。 随着每一层生成所需的观测特征，相应的预测计算可以在 Prefill 继续执行的同时开始（图 2）。 这使得 Prefill 可以与动作预测以及（若有）未来视频生成过程重叠进行。 然而，并发分支会争夺共享的 GPU 计算资源，因此仅通过重叠执行所能实现的加速效果存在上限。

paragraphs.en: To ease this contention, we exploit temporal redundancy across observations to reduce the Prefill workload. Changes in the current observation guide which tokens receive fresh computation, while cached features supply the remaining positions. However, reducing the number of refreshed tokens does not always reduce latency, as different token counts can fall within the same latency plateau (Table 3 , right). We use this available capacity to refresh additional tokens with larger feature changes in the first layer, limiting reuse error at little extra latency. This reuse policy accounts for hardware latency and reduces the workload competing with prediction while keeping observation features current.
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解这种竞争，我们利用观测数据中的时间冗余来减少预填充的工作量。 当前观测数据的变化会决定哪些标记需要重新计算，而缓存的特征则用于填充其余位置。 然而，减少重新计算的标记数量并不总能降低延迟，因为不同的标记数量可能处于相同的延迟平台（表 3，右侧）。 我们利用这种可用容量，在第一层中重新计算特征变化较大的额外标记，从而在几乎没有额外延迟的情况下限制重复使用错误。 这种重复使用策略考虑了硬件延迟，减少了与预测竞争的工作量，同时保持了观测特征的时效性。

paragraphs.en: Token reuse reduces the cost of the first stage, but subsequent denoising still requires repeated network evaluations. To further accelerate inference, we adapt the refresh schedule of cached Transformer residuals according to predicted motion. A coarse action prediction provides a displacement signal for deciding whether further refinement is needed. Motion amplitude and the effect of additional computation vary within an episode (Figure 3 ), motivating a budget adapted to motion. We allocate fewer evaluations to large predicted movements to favor rapid replanning, while retaining additional evaluations for small adjustments. We evaluate this allocation through closed-loop ablations in Section 4.4 and paired prediction comparisons in Appendix E . Refinement continues from the same initial denoising trajectory, preserving the computation already performed.

paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了一种由层依赖关系指导的并行调度方案，该方案将观察处理与动作预测重叠执行，并在适用时同步进行未来视频生成。

paragraphs.en: We develop a token reuse policy that reduces the Prefill workload and exploits hardware latency plateaus to refresh additional informative tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们制定了一项令牌重用策略，该策略能够减少预填充的工作负载，并利用硬件延迟平台来刷新更多信息丰富的令牌。

paragraphs.en: We adapt Transformer residual caching to predicted motion, using the displacement of a coarse action prediction to determine whether further refinement is needed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Transformer 残差缓存适配到预测运动中，利用粗略动作预测的位移来判断是否需要进一步优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two WAM architectures on three simulation benchmarks and five real-world tasks, with controlled experiments examining execution, token allocation, and predictive refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个模拟基准和五个真实世界任务上评估了两种 WAM 架构，并通过受控实验研究了执行、令牌分配和预测优化。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate RealtimeWAM on simulation and real-world manipulation tasks, and ablate execution optimizations, token reuse, and motion-adaptive refinement.

paragraphs.en: Backbones, benchmarks, and baselines. We evaluate FastWAM and OpenWAM on RoboTwin 2.0 clean/randomized ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2026 ) . Each backbone’s native inference is the reference; VLA-Cache ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , TeaCache ( Liu et al., 2025a ) , ToCa ( Zou et al., 2025 ) , and BAC ( Ji et al., 2026a ) provide training-free caching baselines. We enable compilation and CUDA Graph replay for the caching baselines and RealtimeWAM. Baselines retain their original execution schedules; RealtimeWAM adds the proposed parallel execution. Table 1 reports success rates per setting and equally weighted averages over the four settings. LIBERO category results appear in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 主干模型、基准测试与基线模型。 我们在 RoboTwin 2.0 的干净/随机化版本（Chen et al., 2025）、LIBERO（Liu et al., 2023）以及 LIBERO-Plus（Fei et al., 2026）上对 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 进行了评估。 每个主干模型的原始推理结果作为参考；VLA-Cache（Xu et al., 2025）、TeaCache（Liu et al., 2025a）、ToCa（Zou et al., 2025）和 BAC（Ji et al., 2026a）提供了无需训练的缓存基线模型。 我们为这些缓存基线模型以及 RealtimeWAM 启用了编译和 CUDA Graph 重播功能。 基线模型保留了其原有的执行调度；RealtimeWAM 则加入了所提出的并行执行机制。 表 1 报告了每种设置下的成功率，以及四种设置的等权重平均值。 LIBERO 类别的结果见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: RealtimeWAM combines parallel execution, hardware-aware token reuse, and motion-adaptive refinement in a training-free framework. On FastWAM and OpenWAM, measured average speedups reach 8.90 × \times and 10.67 × \times , with success rates within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference. Across five real-world tasks, average success rates improve by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: RealtimeWAM 在一个无需训练的框架中结合了并行执行、硬件感知型令牌重用和运动自适应优化。 在 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 上，测得的平均加速倍数分别达到 8.90 × \times 和 10.67 × \times ，其成功率与原生推理的差距在 0.02 至 0.53 个百分点之间。 在五个真实世界任务中，平均成功率分别提升了 17.2 和 37.2 个百分点。

sents.en: On FastWAM and OpenWAM, measured average speedups reach 8.90 × \times and 10.67 × \times , with success rates within 0.02 and 0.53 percentage points of native inference.
sents.zh: 在 FastWAM 和 OpenWAM 上，测得的平均加速倍数分别达到 8.90 × \times 和 10.67 × \times ，其成功率与原生推理的差距在 0.02 至 0.53 个百分点之间。

sents.en: Across five real-world tasks, average success rates improve by 17.2 and 37.2 percentage points.

paragraphs.en: We compare native inference with RealtimeWAM on both FastWAM and OpenWAM. Each task uses 50 trials per backbone and inference configuration, with the same synchronous inference and action execution policy across the comparison. Each inference request predicts a chunk of 32 future actions. The robot executes actions at a control frequency of 20 Hz. Inference runs locally, with negligible network transmission latency. Table 5 lists the task goals; its task IDs match the rollout rows in Figure 7 . Table 4 reports success rate and measured mean inference latency; its averages weight the five tasks equally.

paragraphs.en: We use the benchmark environments’ task-success checks. A rollout succeeds if the task goal is satisfied within the evaluation horizon; otherwise it fails. RoboTwin uses 100 rollouts per task in each of its Clean and Random settings. LIBERO uses 50 rollouts per task with the released initial-state sets and goal predicates; Long denotes libero_10 . LIBERO-Plus uses one rollout per perturbed task variant, covering changes to layout, cameras, robot initial state, language, lighting, background, and sensor noise ( Fei et al., 2026 ) . These protocols apply to both backbones and all methods in Table 1 .

paragraphs.en: We use the officially released fine-tuned checkpoints of FastWAM and OpenWAM. paragraphs.en: We compare 14 observation pairs from one FastWAM trajectory and 44 pairs from four OpenWAM adjust_bottle trajectories, eight environment steps apart. The larger relative reduction in the small-motion group partly reflects its smaller normalization denominator; its absolute 2F deviation is also lower.

The two deviation strips use 2F/4F predictions against 10F, with the relative metric above and a common range of 0–0.25. Images are recorded request inputs. Panel b uses schematic paths and task-tolerance radii.
